<script>
function animCount(id, end, suffix, dec) {
  const el = document.getElementById(id);
  let s = 0, steps = 60, inc = end / steps;
  const t = setInterval(() => {
    s += inc;
    if (s >= end) { s = end; clearInterval(t); }
    el.textContent = (dec ? s.toFixed(3) : Math.round(s)) + suffix;
  }, 25);
}
setTimeout(() => {
  animCount('s1', 12, '', false);
  animCount('s2', 6, '', false);
  animCount('s3', 87, '%', false);
  animCount('s4', 0.645, '', true);
}, 400);
setTimeout(() => {
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-w]').forEach(el => el.style.width = el.dataset.w + '%');
}, 700);
</script>
